notes.title: World Championship Boxing Manager™ 2's Muxy integration is now live!
notes.content:
The World Championship Boxing Manager 2 [url=https://www.muxy.io/]Muxy[/url] Integration is now live! Experience what it’s like to go toe-to-toe against your Twitch audience. Will your audience send your gym for a night out partying or a great night of rest? Find out when you poll them to decide your fate! You can get the extension [url=https://dashboard.twitch.tv/extensions/04vyxms9n38lkfls9o0i0fpoahfxjg-0.0.4]here[/url] and learn how to install and pair it [url=https://www.muxy.io/post/wcbm2-twitch-extension-faq]here[/url]. 

With the Boxing Manager 2 - Ring Master Twitch Extension, viewers can:
[list]
[*] Vote on Trinkets to buff up your fighter
[*] Control opponent tactics and items to keep those fights spicy
[*] Vote for Random Events during training and management sequences to put a monkey wrench in carefully planned training regimens
[*] One member of chat can use Channel Points to play as your opponent. The opponent will be renamed to their Twitch name and they’ll have full control of tactics and item decisions.
[/list]

Streamers: These features are only available during career-mode, not story-mode. Currently only in the PC version.

notes.title: Patch notes for v.0.14.0.0
notes.content:
We’ve listened! WCBM2 is now leaner and meaner than ever with some quality-of-life improvements, more visibility into how your boxer’s training impacts their stats, and a KO minigame to fend off being knocked out and to get your boxer backup and in the fight.

One of the biggest updates is the KO minigame which gives players one opportunity to revive their fallen boxer. A button prompt appears for players to mash a button (A for controllers, Enter for M&K). If players can press the button enough times within a given time, then their boxers will stay in the fight with slightly restored health.

The in-game economy has been rebalanced to give players more money for winning fights. However, gym training will now cost a small amount of money, which incentivizes players to be smart about how much their boxers are training versus how often they need to win fights.

You can find the full patch notes for World Championship Boxing Manager™ 2 update below, which also includes fixes and improvements. Check it out before you head back into the ring!
[list]
[*] KO minigame
[*] New tutorials in career mode (KO minigame and ranking up)
[*] Tutorial for prize fights in story mode added
[*] New Muxy UI (for Twitch integration)
[*] Records tracking for the Accuracy stat fixed
[*] Training costs money (new feature)
[*] Trainer's impact on stats and fights fixed
[*] Some fight sprites not showing
[*] German localization fixes (general text going out of bounds in some instances)
[*] Updated credits
[*] Better loading times
[*] Cinematic aspect ratio fixed
[*] Pause out of focus removed
[*] An Open Book achievement fixed
[*] Come One Come All achievement fixed
[*] Superhuman achievement fixed
[/list]
